description_compelling: The state reclaims strategic industries — oil and gas, banking, telecoms, mining — through expropriation, forced share transfers, or compulsory licensing. Sovereignty indices, neopatrimonialism scores, and FDI flows shift in the years before. Strongest in resource-dependent states and in populist governments under fiscal pressure.

trajectory_alignment.method: z-aggregated across the emitted positive cases (count in samples_used), aligned by lead-year, gaps linearly interpolated. Pre-§F walks emit head(5) positives; §F-onward emit the full corpus.
